content: Project structure: unzip clean DR copy per game, commit whole thing (private repos ignore only /tmp and /logs); mygame/{app,data,fonts,metadata,sounds,sprites}; entry mygame/app/main.rb; 7.x idiom is module Main with boot/start/tick/reset; no gems/bundler; require 'app/x.rb' relative to mygame. Source: docs guides/starting-a-new-project.md, changelog 7.4.
